## Description {#details}

<p>Recipe to generate a scalar PHI.</p>


<p>Used to generate code for recipes that produce scalar header phis, including <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/vpcanonicalivphirecipe">VPCanonicalIVPHIRecipe</a> and <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/vpevlbasedivphirecipe">VPEVLBasedIVPHIRecipe</a>.</p>


<p>Definition at line 2267 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/transforms/lib/transforms/vectorize/vplan-h">VPlan.h</a>.</p>
